about.p1: Amiko Solutions was born in Santa Rita do Sapucaí (MG), the “Electronics Valley”, inside the Incubator of the National Institute of Telecommunications – INATEL, one of the largest technological innovation hubs in the country.
about.p2: Our inspiration came from a personal experience of our CEO, Roberto Pinheiro, who during a hospital stay noticed flaws in patient care processes. This moment sparked the determination to create solutions that combine cutting-edge technology with human care, helping healthcare institutions evolve in a practical, sustainable, and patient-centered way.
about.p3: With over 15 years of experience in technology and 3 years of direct involvement in the hospital sector, we have already supported more than 5 hospitals and connected over 150 people to solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and promote quality of life within the hospital environment.
about.p4: We believe that innovation in healthcare is born from listening to those on the front lines and those who rely on these services. That’s why every Amiko product and service is developed in a personalized way, respecting the context of each institution, integrating into daily hospital routines, and bringing real benefits to patients, teams, and managers.
about.p5: Our commitment goes beyond technology: we strive to generate a positive impact on patients’ well-being, support healthcare professionals, and promote the sustainability of the planet.
services.s1.p1: MOARA is a bedside virtual assistant powered by artificial intelligence, designed to raise the standard of hospital care. With MOARA, patients can make requests using only their voice, eliminating communication barriers and facilitating interaction with the care team, as the assistant also prioritizes and forwards requests to the appropriate department, speeding up the service process.
services.s1.c1.p: Only the team responsible for that type of request will receive the call, preventing other teams from being occupied with tasks outside their specialties.
services.s1.c2.p: We deliver accurate and real data on service calls, enabling decision-making based on the actual situation. This allows for better performance management in real time.
services.s1.c3.p: Each type of request can be sent to the corresponding team and already contains exactly what the patient asked for, avoiding unnecessary visits to the room.
services.s2.p1: SIMOH is an innovative hospital monitoring system designed for areas that require continuous control. With SIMOH, manual verification processes are drastically reduced, allowing for efficient and accurate real-time monitoring. This system generates crucial indicators that provide valuable insights for hospital management, making decision-making easier and data-driven. Additionally, SIMOH allows for monitoring of various areas and equipment, ensuring a safe and functional hospital environment.
services.s2.c1.p: Provides valuable insights for hospital management, enabling decisions based on reliable, up-to-date information.
services.s2.c2.p: Allows monitoring of various hospital areas and equipment, ensuring a safe and functional environment for patients and medical staff.
services.s2.c3.p: By detecting problems early, it helps minimize errors and incidents, promoting patient safety and operational efficiency in the hospital.
services.s3.p1: We develop customized, on-demand solutions for the unique challenges faced in hospital environments. Whether through the development of specialized software or hardware, our approach aims to significantly improve the efficiency and quality of healthcare delivery. By focusing on solutions tailored to each healthcare institution’s specific needs, we solve problems that are often overlooked by generic solutions.
services.s3.c1.p: Provides valuable insights for hospital management, enabling decisions based on reliable, up-to-date information.
services.s3.c2.p: Allows monitoring of various hospital areas and equipment, ensuring a safe and functional environment for patients and staff.
services.s3.c3.p: By detecting problems early, it helps minimize errors and incidents, promoting patient safety and hospital operational efficiency.
moara.p1: MOARA is a name of Brazilian Indigenous origin meaning “the one who helps.” This meaning represents the purpose of the virtual assistant developed by Amiko Solutions: to always be there to assist, welcome, and support during delicate moments like a hospital stay.
moara.p2: Created to be a concierge available 24/7, MOARA connects patients and care teams, ensuring agility, comfort, and excellence in service. More than just technology, it symbolizes care and closeness during a vulnerable period, where every detail matters.

feedbacks.f1.name: Alexandre Coelho
feedbacks.f1.role: Nossa Senhora das Dores Hospital - Executive Director
feedbacks.f1.p1: Investing in new technologies and partnerships with startups that can further improve the customer journey and enhance their experience is essential for the future of healthcare. At HNSD, this will be frequent, as we combine our hospital’s tradition with innovation in care as one of our growth goals.
feedbacks.f2.name: Joyce Cristina
feedbacks.f2.role: Santa Casa Misericórdia de Passos - Hospitality
feedbacks.f2.p1: We are using the MOARA system, and it has been very useful for our work, making our tasks easier and more efficient. The patient requests something, and through the system, we can already see what they need without having to go to the room twice. This way, we can attend to the patient more quickly. I had never seen this system in hospitals. I loved the idea.
feedbacks.f3.name: Bianca Sofia
feedbacks.f3.p1: It’s a technology you don’t see everywhere. I found it very practical, mainly because it ensures that we are attended to more quickly. We are already very satisfied with the humanized care we receive here, and now it’s going to get even better.
feedbacks.f4.name: Lo-Ami
feedbacks.f4.role: Santa Casa Misericórdia de Passos - Companion
feedbacks.f4.p1: I had the privilege of being the first companion to test it, and it was an honor. I believe it will greatly improve the interaction between hospital, companion, and patient. Today, I was with a patient and couldn’t leave them alone, so I sent a request through MOARA asking for juice. It was super fast, and soon the staff brought it to me. The system has really come to add a lot of value!
feedbacks.f5.name: Emilene
feedbacks.f5.role: Santa Casa Misericórdia de Passos - Hospitality
feedbacks.f5.p1: I am an employee at Santa Casa de Passos. This week, MOARA was installed, and it will greatly contribute to both patients and the nursing and hospitality teams by optimizing response time. Patients who have already used the system are delighted with the innovation. Congratulations to everyone involved!
feedbacks.f6.name: Bruno Moreira
feedbacks.f6.role: Santa Casa de Belo Horizonte - Head of Healthcare Innovation
feedbacks.f6.p1: Our goal is for the care team to spend more time caring for people and less time on bureaucracy, providing increasingly personalized care, which is the future of medicine. We are building a truly technological healthcare journey.
feedbacks.f7.name: Bruna de Oliveira
feedbacks.f7.p1: The MOARA technology has made our work much easier. It is an easy-to-use device, so the adaptation has been very smooth. When a patient calls us with a problem, we can already come with a solution.
